newsitem.title: CHINA: FORECAST- China RPI seen up 5.5 pct in '97.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST- China RPI seen up 5.5 pct in '97.

text.p: China's retail price inflation is forecast to be 5.5 percent this year, the Economic Daily on Monday quoted a report from the State Planning Commission as saying.
China's retail price inflation was 6.1 percent in 1996, down from 14.8 percent in 1995 and from a communist-era high of 21.7 percent in 1994, state media said.
Gross domestic product (GDP) growth was expected to be 10 percent this year, it said.
Fixed asset investment in 1997 would rise by 19 percent compared with last year, the report said.
Retail sales of consumer goods were forecast to increase by 18 percent, or an inflation-adjusted rise of 12 percent over last year, it said.
Exports were forecast to grow by a year-on-year 12 percent in 1997, it said.
